svg.title: Overview of the JPEG XL codec architecture
svg.desc: Figure 6 from The JPEG XL Image Coding System: History, Features, Coding Tools, Design Rationale, and Future, by Jon Sneyers, Jyrki Alakuijala, Luca Versari, Zoltán Szabadka, Sami Boukortt, Amnon Cohen-Tidhar, Moritz Firsching, Evgenii Kliuchnikov, Tal Lev-Ami, Eric Portis, Thomas Richter, and Osamu Watanabe (2025), arXiv:2506.05987v2, page 14. Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.05987v2. Extracted from the PDF figure without the page header or caption; labels converted to paths and a white background added. Original embedded raster drop shadows retained. The diagram covers RGB and extra-channel inputs, VarDCT and Modular encoding, JPEG reconstruction, the codestream and container, and decoding.
